resources.string: Main aapki tutorial guide hoon. Koi feature seekhne ke liye uski screen par jaakar mujhe tap karein. Main aapko uska istemaal sikhaungi.
Main abhi is screen ke baare mein seekh rahi hoon. Abhi in features ki practice kar sakte hain:
Hi! Main aapki kaise madad kar sakti hoon?
Hi, %1$s! Main aapki kaise madad kar sakti hoon?
Batayein aapko kis cheez mein help chahiye. Hamari team yahin reply karegi.
Aapki query bhej di gayi hai. Reply aane par aap use yahin padh sakte hain.
Queries load nahi hui. Dobara try karne ke liye Refresh karein.
Query send nahi hui. Aapka text yahin hai; dobara try karein.
Query bhejne aur replies padhne ke liye sign in karein.
Habit banane ke liye Add tap karein. Naam dein aur follow karne ke din chunein.
Habit poori hone par Today mein done mark karein. Progress ke liye Weekly ya Monthly dekhein.
Schedule ya reminder badalne ke liye habit kholein. Consistency ke liye Insights dekhein.
Setup ki jaankari padhein aur zaroori accessibility permission dein. Permission guide aapko tareeka dikhayegi.
Padhai waale YouTube channels add karein aur allowed channels chunein.
Setup finish karke YouTube Focus on karein. Channels badalne ya ise off karne ke liye is screen par lautein.
